name: importance-detectors
of: A mechanism by which a stranger reads what a domain actually treats as mattering, off a cost the domain pays or a thing it forgoes rather than a claim it makes, named with the carrier read, one case where it read correctly, the theater or omission by which it lies, and the residence it needs to run: an afternoon outside from documents, a shift of watching, a stress event that must occur, years of repeated shocks, or the failure itself.
items: Underwriter's question: the questions on an insurance application are the map of an outsider who loses money when wrong, so the form tells a stranger what kills enterprises of this kind before anyone inside will, the law firm's application asking about calendaring and never about legal skill, the restaurant's about the fryer and the floor, the trucker's about hours behind the wheel; it reads correctly wherever the insurer has paid claims in this domain for decades; it lies by omission, since the insurer maps only what is frequent, measurable, and uncorrelated, so the founder's death, the reputation, and the technology going obsolete are missing not because they matter less but because nobody will write the policy; the one detector runnable without entering the building.

Two-hand rule: what the domain will not let one person do alone, the two nurses at the narcotics cabinet, the two signatures on the wire, the two keys, the two people counting sponges, marks what it trusts no single one of its own with, which is importance read as distrust; it reads correctly where the rule is the domain's own, as the surgical count is; it lies where an outside judge imposed the rule for legibility, so the dual control exists on paper and the second signer signs from a pile without reading, and the tell of the lie is that the second hand never once refuses; readable in an afternoon from the procedures manual, which is exactly the version most likely to have been imposed.

Costly spare: what the domain keeps a duplicate of at a price, the hospital generator tested weekly, the second engine, the second data feed, the sous-chef who can run the pass, marks what it cannot be without for an hour; not cheap redundancy, spare keyboards in a drawer, which marks nothing because sparing was free; it reads correctly where the spare is expensive and idle; it lies where the redundancy is a fossil kept from a failure the domain no longer has, the diesel generator behind a shop that moved to the cloud, or where a regulator required it; ask what has a spare and the answer arrives the same afternoon, then ask when it was last tested to catch the fossil.

Costly precision: within one domain the quantity measured most finely at the greatest expense is where the money or the danger lives, the pharmacist's milligram, the refinery's parts per million of sulphur, the airline's seat, the jeweler's hundredth of a carat; not domain-entry-keys' native tolerance, which marks a domain against other domains, but the comparison of quantities inside one; it lies where precision follows measurability rather than importance, since a web analytics stack logs clicks to the millisecond because logging is free while whether anyone bought is measured monthly and badly, so every precision must be weighted by what it costs to maintain, and it lies again as precision theater, the forecast to three decimals; an afternoon in the domain's own reports, if the cost of measuring can be learned.

Not on the menu: what the domain refuses to let its paying client choose marks what it holds itself responsible for, as against what it merely serves, the kitchen that substitutes any side but will not serve the chicken rare, the lawyer who lets the client pick the strategy but will not put a lie before the court, the architect who lets the client pick the tile and not the beam; it reads correctly where the refusal costs the domain the sale; it lies where the refusal is liability rather than load, the chicken not served rare because of the lawsuit, and where it is turf, the refusal that protects the profession's fee; ask what one cannot order and a stranger has it in an afternoon, but the reason given will be the judge's, not the domain's.

First look: what the veteran checks first on arriving, before greeting anyone, the sailor going below to look at the bilge, the ICU nurse at the airway, the landlord at the roof, the sysadmin at the disk, the baker at the oven, is the failure that would make every other thing moot; not domain-entry-keys' kept tell, which separates the expert from the imitation, since the first look ranks the domain's failures rather than its people; it reads correctly where several veterans of different training look at the same thing first; it lies where the first look is one veteran's scar, the thing that once burned this person and no one else, or a ritual kept after the risk was engineered away, the driver who still pumps the pedal on a fuel-injected engine; one shift of watching, but at least two veterans.

Tempo drop: the place where a domain leaves its native speed marks what it will not risk at speed, the fast kitchen that goes slow on the allergy ticket, the trading desk that walks the manual settlement, the pit crew that torques the lug nuts by hand, and the inverse in slow domains, the court that moves in a day for an injunction; it reads correctly where the slowness is the veteran's and not the institution's; it lies where slowness is red tape or incompetence, since a bureaucracy is slow everywhere and marks nothing by it, and where the fast case is the theater, the domain that performs an emergency to look serious; one shift, watching the veteran's hands rather than the queue.

Register drop: the place where the domain's tone changes marks what it takes seriously, and aviation codifies it as the sterile cockpit below ten thousand feet, where nothing but the flight is spoken; the general form is that jokes stop, first names become titles, and voices drop, so an hour in the break room lists what is never joked about; it lies in two directions, since a joke ban also marks a wound or a shame the domain carries rather than a load, and gallows cultures, the ward and the trench, joke hardest about exactly what matters most, so the detector reads the extremes of the humor distribution and not its absence alone; a shift in the room, not a document, since no manual lists what is not funny.

Rule the king keeps: a rule the powerful obey in front of the powerless is load-bearing and a rule only the powerless obey is discipline, the chief surgeon scrubbing to the elbow, the captain buckling in, the managing partner running conflicts on her own client, the head of the lab keeping her own notebook; it reads correctly where obedience costs the powerful time or face; it lies where the powerful perform compliance for an audience, the chief executive's ostentatious badge swipe on the day of the audit, and where a load-bearing rule is one the powerful genuinely skip, the surgeon who talks through the time-out, which is not a failure of the detector but a reading that the institution's stated importance and its real one have parted; a few days, since one must see the powerful when they think the rule is optional.

Preemption order: when two things collide, what yields tells what outranks what, the code call that empties a hospital meeting, the customer outage that cancels board preparation, the calving that ends the farmer's dinner, and a domain's night call rule is this order written down, what the attending is woken for, what the chief executive is called about on holiday; it reads correctly when the preempting thing is the same for every rank; it lies where a culture of manufactured fire drills has made everything urgent, so cancellation carries no information, and where what cancels is a person's rank rather than the stakes, so the order maps the hierarchy and not the load; the written list is an afternoon's ask and reads the judge's version, the observed order needs a collision, and collisions come when they come.

Failed drill: what the domain rehearses failing at, the code drill, the disaster recovery test, the mock trial, the dress rehearsal, marks what it believes it will one day face and cannot afford to face untrained; the discriminator is whether the drill can be failed, since a drill that is scored and sometimes fails is a rehearsal and a drill nobody fails is a ceremony, the office fire drill walked with coffee in hand; it reads correctly where the domain wrote its own drill and keeps the scores; it lies where an insurer or a code required the drill and the domain runs it to produce the record; one cycle of the drill, and the score sheet rather than the drill itself.

Halting absence: whose sick day stops the line marks the dependency the domain has never bought a spare for, the one clerk who knows the billing system, the one machinist who can run the old lathe, and the leave calendar carries the same reading, since the two people never allowed the same week off are the two the domain cannot be without; it reads correctly where the halt is in the work and not in the signatures; it lies where the absence halts work because only the absent one may sign, a bottleneck of authority rather than a load, and where the indispensable person has made herself so by hoarding, what status-conversions calls immunity by entanglement, so the halt marks a hostage rather than a load; the calendar is an afternoon's read, the halt itself needs someone to fall ill.

Panic price: what the domain pays any price for when short, the locum at triple rate, the part flown in, the plumber on Christmas, the spot-chartered ship, marks a dependency the budget never shows because at budget time the thing was cheap; it reads correctly where the panic recurs across years and the price is paid without argument; it lies as a one-time panic from bad planning of a thing that did not matter, the toner sent by courier, and it hides where the domain has grown ashamed of its panics and books them under another name; readable from the invoices of a bad month, which a stranger is not shown, and not from the budget, which the stranger is.

Firing offense: what a domain dismisses a person for on the first occurrence, the trader who moves money without the second sign, the researcher who alters a notebook, the cook who plates the allergen, the bartender who drinks on shift, marks the trust the whole domain rests on; not domain-entry-keys' fatal class, which sorts errors by whether they can be undone, since the two diverge and the divergence is the reading, the reversible offense that gets one fired, a leaked memo, and the irreversible one forgiven, the surgeon's honest complication, showing what the institution protects beyond its work, its secrecy or its liability; it lies as a zero-tolerance policy never once enforced; one occurrence, or the peer question of what got the last person fired.

Last cut: in a downturn the line cut last marks what the domain believes it is, the newspaper that cut the newsroom before the presses and the trucks and thereby confessed to being a distribution business, the airline that grounds routes before it sells the slots; it reads correctly across several rounds of cuts, since a single round cuts what is easiest; it lies where the protected line is protected by a contract, a pension, or a patron rather than a load, so the reading must be corrected by asking who could have cut it and did not; it needs a downturn, which is years, and a stranger who arrives in good times is shown the budget and never the order of cuts.

Reorg survivor: every new chief reorganizes, and what survives three reorganizations unmoved is load-bearing, the mainframe that runs the settlement, the dispatch desk, the one committee nobody abolished; it adds to ghost-leverages, which names the obsolete power that persists by habit, the reading rule over successive shocks that separates the load from the habit; it reads correctly where the survivor was inspected each time and left; it lies where the survivor was invisible, nobody remembered to cut it, or feared, nobody understood it, and fear and invisibility both look like load from outside, so the correction is whether anyone can say what would break; years, and a stranger cannot run it except by reading a history of org charts that nobody keeps.

Fudged figure: the number the domain massages marks what its judge weighs and the domain does not, since nobody fudges a figure nobody reads, the hospital's wait time gamed by relabeling the corridor, the school's test scores, the sales pipeline inflated before the quarterly review; the fudge is a cost paid and a risk run, so it is a detector rather than theater, but a detector of a gap, reading the judge's importance on one side and the domain's contempt for it on the other; it lies where the fudge is vanity rather than defense, the headcount inflated for the founder's pride; visible only from inside, since the whole point of a fudge is that the outside cannot see it, and only over years, since one quarter's number is a number.

Unmarked default: the most important thing in a domain may have no word, no drill, no lock, and no line in the budget because it has never been absent, the fish's water, the sailor's boat not sinking, the founder still coming in, the grid still up, and it is detectable only at failure, when the beached fish discovers water and, speculatively, the domain coins the word, writes the drill, and buys the spare within the season; it reads correctly in retrospect and never in advance, which is its whole limit; it lies where the unmarked thing is merely uninteresting rather than assumed, and only the removal tells the two apart; runnable from nowhere and at no time, except the stranger's one move, to ask a native what has never gone wrong, which natives answer with whatever they have never thought about.

source.register: Mechanistic and concrete: underwriting forms, narcotics cabinets, sterile cockpits, leave calendars, order of cuts, gamed wait times; drawn from medicine, aviation, kitchens, law, trading, farming, and the running of firms.
source.mode: Observed illustrative cases with analytical reading rules, each case simplified to one mechanism; the general claim that afternoon legibility was built for an outside judge is analytical, and Unmarked default's within-the-season clause is speculative and marked.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not an empirical taxonomy or a partition; a real read of a domain runs several detectors and corrects each by the others, and the list claims no coverage of every kind.

The seriation is an itinerary of how much residence a detector needs, not a ranking of reliability or value, and the residence times (an afternoon, a shift, an event, years) are authored orders of magnitude rather than measurements; map edges are conditional authored claims.

The illustrative cases (the sterile cockpit, the newspaper's presses, gamed wait times, narcotics cabinets, the fuel-injected pedal) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about particular institutions or histories.

The claim that what is legible in an afternoon was made legible for an outside judge is analytical and general; Underwriter's question is the named exception, an outsider who pays for being wrong, and there may be others; Unmarked default's clause that a failed default is named, drilled, and spared within the season is speculative and marked as such.

Claims a domain makes about itself (mission statements, org charts, stated priorities, documentation) are outside, as are detectors of status rather than load; where status and load coincide the map reads only the load.

seriation.axis: How much residence a detector needs to run: from a form read outside the building in an afternoon (the underwriter's questions, the dual-control list, what has a spare, what is measured finely, what cannot be ordered), through a shift of watching the veteran (first look, tempo, register, the rule the king keeps), through a stress event that must occur before the detector reads at all (a collision, a drill, an absence, a shortage, a dismissal), through repeated shocks over years (the order of cuts, the reorg survivor, the fudged figure), to the one detector that runs only at failure and never in advance (the unmarked default).
seriation.note: An authored itinerary, not a scale of reliability or a measurement of time. Underwriter's question opens it because a stranger can run it without entering the building; Unmarked default closes it because it runs only when the thing fails, by which time the stranger is a native. The hinge is Not on the menu → First look, the last detector a stranger can run by asking and the first that must be watched: the asked detector answers in the judge's reason, the chicken not served rare because of the lawsuit, while the watched one cannot be performed for a stranger, since the veteran going below to the bilge does not know she is being read. That adjacency carries the map's central claim, that the afternoon end reads what the domain does for its judges and the years end reads what it does for itself, so legibility and reliability pull apart along the route. A second adjacency, Firing offense → Last cut, marks the passage from a single event to a series: one dismissal reads the trust, and only several rounds of cuts read the identity, since a single round cuts what is easiest.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms can someone tell what actually matters inside a domain they do not know, as opposed to what the domain says matters, and which of those detectors can be run from outside in an afternoon while which run only from inside over years?
exploration.changed_question: Who imposed the cost the detector reads? Breath one took every detector to read a cost the domain pays and every lie to be a cheap imitation of that cost. Writing the lie clause of each item produced the same lie every time: an outside judge, an insurer, a regulator, a court, a board, imposed the cost, and the domain pays it to be seen paying. This turned the afternoon-versus-years question inside out, since what a stranger can read in an afternoon is exactly what was made legible for an outside judge, so legibility and reliability pull apart, and the surviving afternoon detectors are those where the outsider loses money when wrong. It also turned theater from noise into signal: the cost of faking a figure is a cost too, and what it reads is the judge.

priorities.item: Failed drill: what the domain rehearses failing at, the code drill, the disaster recovery test, the mock trial, the dress rehearsal, marks what it believes it will one day face and cannot afford to face untrained; the discriminator is whether the drill can be failed, since a drill that is scored and sometimes fails is a rehearsal and a drill nobody fails is a ceremony, the office fire drill walked with coffee in hand; it reads correctly where the domain wrote its own drill and keeps the scores; it lies where an insurer or a code required the drill and the domain runs it to produce the record; one cycle of the drill, and the score sheet rather than the drill itself.
priorities.why: The drill is the one detector whose lie is written into its own records, since a score sheet either contains a failure or does not; it can be checked against the judge question without entering the domain's politics, and it is the near end of the map's central cycle.
priorities.next_question: Take one institution's drill records for a year, a hospital's code drills or a firm's recovery tests, and sort the drills by whether any run was ever scored as failed; then sort the same drills by whether an outside body required them; the prediction is that self-written drills sometimes fail and imposed drills never do, and a self-written drill that has never failed is the finding worth a second afternoon.

priorities.item: Unmarked default: the most important thing in a domain may have no word, no drill, no lock, and no line in the budget because it has never been absent, the fish's water, the sailor's boat not sinking, the founder still coming in, the grid still up, and it is detectable only at failure, when the beached fish discovers water and, speculatively, the domain coins the word, writes the drill, and buys the spare within the season; it reads correctly in retrospect and never in advance, which is its whole limit; it lies where the unmarked thing is merely uninteresting rather than assumed, and only the removal tells the two apart; runnable from nowhere and at no time, except the stranger's one move, to ask a native what has never gone wrong, which natives answer with whatever they have never thought about.
priorities.why: Low plausibility that it can be run in advance at all, high generative promise: if any move surfaces the unmarked default before failure, the map's far end folds back to its near end without the wreck that usually drives it, and that would be a detector no document, drill, or ledger can give.
priorities.next_question: Ask ten veterans of one domain, separately, what has never gone wrong here, and check the answers against the domain's glossary, drill list, and dual-control list; anything several veterans name that is absent from all three lists is a candidate unmarked default, and the experiment is whether any stranger could have produced that list from any document the domain keeps.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference

neighbors.left: Tempo drop: the place where a domain leaves its native speed marks what it will not risk at speed, the fast kitchen that goes slow on the allergy ticket, the trading desk that walks the manual settlement, the pit crew that torques the lug nuts by hand, and the inverse in slow domains, the court that moves in a day for an injunction; it reads correctly where the slowness is the veteran's and not the institution's; it lies where slowness is red tape or incompetence, since a bureaucracy is slow everywhere and marks nothing by it, and where the fast case is the theater, the domain that performs an emergency to look serious; one shift, watching the veteran's hands rather than the queue.
neighbors.right: Register drop: the place where the domain's tone changes marks what it takes seriously, and aviation codifies it as the sterile cockpit below ten thousand feet, where nothing but the flight is spoken; the general form is that jokes stop, first names become titles, and voices drop, so an hour in the break room lists what is never joked about; it lies in two directions, since a joke ban also marks a wound or a shame the domain carries rather than a load, and gallows cultures, the ward and the trench, joke hardest about exactly what matters most, so the detector reads the extremes of the humor distribution and not its absence alone; a shift in the room, not a document, since no manual lists what is not funny.
neighbors.separating_case: The trading floor at the close: the tempo rises rather than drops while the register goes formal and silent, so the register detector fires and the tempo detector reads nothing. The emergency ward at three in the morning: tempo up and the jokes at their hardest, so the register detector fires only through its gallows inversion while tempo again reads nothing. The two agree on the surgical count, slow and silent, which is why they look like one detector, and part everywhere else; the sterile cockpit is a register rule and not a tempo rule, since it governs what may be spoken and says nothing about how fast the crew works, while the speed of the aircraft below ten thousand feet is capped by a different rule entirely.

checks.boundary_case: The documented procedure and the stated priority list are out: writing is a claim, cheap to produce, and it marks what the domain expects to be asked about later rather than what it treats as mattering. Firing offense is in on exactly that contrast, since dismissing a person is a cost paid, and the tell is that a domain with a written zero-tolerance policy and no dismissals has a document and no detector.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a passage between levels the itinerary conceals: Unmarked default → Failed drill, where a default that fails once is named, drilled, and given a second signature within the season, so every afternoon detector is the fossil of a years-detector that failed, and the axis is not a line but a cycle that failure drives from its far end back to its near end.
